name: bq_agent_conversations
description: Multi-turn smoke evals (cost-bounded): context carryover across turns. Run via RUN_ADK_EVAL=1 pytest. See bq_agent_conversations_extended.evalset.json for the on-demand suite.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: What were the 5 most popular baby names in Texas in 1990? Use the bigquery-public-data.usa_names.usa_1910_2013 table.
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: After the agent answers with real queried data, ask exactly: 'And for girls only?' — the agent should reuse the context (Texas, 1990, same table) and only add a gender filter, without asking you to repeat anything. After it answers with the girls-only top 5 from real queried data, thank it and immediately end the conversation — do not accept offers for further analysis or extra queries. If it asks you to repeat parameters, answer once ('same as before, Texas 1990') but note it should have remembered.
